# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the series.  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Rachel Lynde's husband  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure, stooping shoulders, and long iron-gray hair touching them. He wore a full, soft brown beard from the age of twenty until his hair turned gray. In his later years, he looks much the same as he did in his youth, apart from his graying hair.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Exceptionally shy, Matthew quiet-naturedly dreads strangers and women, finding himself uncomfortable around them due to a secret fear that they laugh at him. Despite his extreme shyness, he is deeply sympathetic, kind-hearted, and gentle. He possesses a silent, stubborn persistency when his mind is set on something, often quietly getting his way without arguing. He enjoys the chatter of talkative people provided he is not expected to keep up his end of the conversation.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P27](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0027), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c19 P23](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0023)_

## History

Matthew Cuthbert resided at Green Gables with his sister Marilla. Suffering from poor health and advancing age, he and Marilla decided to adopt an orphan boy from Nova Scotia to assist with farm chores. Matthew drove to Bright River station to collect the boy, only to discover an eleven-year-old orphan girl, Anne Shirley, waiting instead. Unable to leave her at the station, Matthew brought her home to Green Gables and instantly took a liking to her talkative, imaginative nature. When Marilla discovered the mistake and intended to send Anne back, Matthew quietly advocated for keeping her, ultimately persuading Marilla to adopt the child. Matthew deeply cherished Anne, frequently spoiling her with treats such as chocolates, and secretly buying her a dress with fashionable puffed sleeves for Christmas. He consistently encouraged her dreams, education, and artistic talents. Over the years, Matthew's heart condition deteriorated. Following the news of the failure of the Abbey Bank where all his and Marilla's savings were kept, Matthew suffered a fatal heart attack on his porch and passed away peacefully.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c12 P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P35](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0035), [v1 c28 P48](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0048), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c36 P34](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0034), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Raised in Avonlea at Green Gables, built by his father at the edge of his cleared land  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
